<details class="result-group" id="theorem-5-2-affine-image-of-a-multivariate-normal" open>
<summary><span>Theorem 5.2 affine image of a multivariate normal</span><span class="result-count">2 endpoints</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>If $X \sim N(\mu,\Sigma)$ and $Y = a + B X$, then $Y \sim N(a + B\mu, B \Sigma B')$</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-map-affine-multivariategaussian">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.map_affine_multivariateGaussian</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p><strong>Hansen Theorem 5.2.</strong> If <code>X ∼ N(μ, Σ)</code>, then <code>a + B X</code> has law
<code>N(a + B μ, B Σ B')</code>. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {m : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype m] [inst_1 : DecidableEq m] [inst_2 : Fintype n]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq n] {μ : EuclideanSpace Real n} {S : Matrix n n Real},
  S.PosSemidef →
    ∀ (a : EuclideanSpace Real m) (B : Matrix m n Real),
      Eq
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.map
          (fun x =&gt;
            instHAdd.hAdd a (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (HansenEconometrics.matrixContinuousLinearMap B) x))
          (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian μ S))
        (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian
          (instHAdd.hAdd a (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (HansenEconometrics.matrixContinuousLinearMap B) μ))
          (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul B S)
            B.conjTranspose))</code></pre>
</details>
<details class="dependency-list"><summary>Direct statement dependencies (1)</summary><ul><li><code>HansenEconometrics.matrixContinuousLinearMap</code></li></ul></details>
<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/MultivariateNormal.lean#L111">HansenEconometrics/MultivariateNormal.lean:111</a></p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-haslaw-affine-multivariategaussian">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.hasLaw_affine_multivariateGaussian</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Random-variable version of Hansen Theorem 5.2. </p></div>

<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m : Type u_2} {n : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype m] [inst_2 : DecidableEq m]
  [inst_3 : Fintype n] [inst_4 : DecidableEq n] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X : Ω → EuclideanSpace Real n}
  {μ : EuclideanSpace Real n} {S : Matrix n n Real},
  S.PosSemidef →
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw X (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian μ S) P →
      ∀ (a : EuclideanSpace Real m) (B : Matrix m n Real),

          (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian
            (instHAdd.hAdd a (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (HansenEconometrics.matrixContinuousLinearMap B) μ))
            (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul (Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid.hMul B S)
              B.conjTranspose))

<details class="result-group" id="theorem-5-3-properties-of-the-multivariate-normal">
<summary><span>Theorem 5.3 properties of the multivariate normal</span><span class="result-count">5 endpoints</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>For $X \sim N(\mu,\Sigma)$: $\mathbb{E}[X] = \mu$, $\operatorname{Var}(X) = \Sigma$, uncorrelated subvectors are independent, affine images are normal, and the standard quadratic-form laws give $\chi^2$, non-central $\chi^2$, and $t/F$ consequences</p></div>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-multivariategaussian-mean">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.multivariateGaussian_mean</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>The mean vector of <code>N(μ, Σ)</code> is <code>μ</code>. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] {μ : EuclideanSpace Real n} {S : Matrix n n Real},
  Eq (MeasureTheory.integral (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian μ S) fun x =&gt; x) μ</code></pre>
</details>

<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/MultivariateNormal.lean#L151">HansenEconometrics/MultivariateNormal.lean:151</a></p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-multivariategaussian-covariancebilin">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.multivariateGaussian_covarianceBilin</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>The covariance bilinear form of <code>N(μ, Σ)</code> is represented by <code>Σ</code>. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] {μ : EuclideanSpace Real n} {S : Matrix n n Real},
  S.PosSemidef →
    ∀ (u v : EuclideanSpace Real n),
      Eq
        (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
          (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
            (ProbabilityTheory.covarianceBilin (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian μ S)) u)

</details>

<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/MultivariateNormal.lean#L158">HansenEconometrics/MultivariateNormal.lean:158</a></p>
</div>
</details>
<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-multivariategaussian-eval-haslaw">

<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>A coordinate projection of a multivariate normal is univariate normal. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {n : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype n] [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] {μ : EuclideanSpace Real n} {S : Matrix n n Real},
  S.PosSemidef →
    ∀ (i : n),
      ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (fun x =&gt; x.ofLp i) (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (μ.ofLp i) (S i i).toNNReal)

</details>

<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-multivariategaussian-restrict-haslaw">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.multivariateGaussian_restrict₂_hasLaw</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>A coordinate subvector of a multivariate normal is multivariate normal with the corresponding

<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {I J : Finset ι}
  {μ : EuclideanSpace Real (Subtype fun x =&gt; SetLike.instMembership.mem I x)}
  {S : Matrix (Subtype fun x =&gt; SetLike.instMembership.mem I x) (Subtype fun x =&gt; SetLike.instMembership.mem I x) Real},
  S.PosSemidef →

<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-jointgaussian-indepfun-iff-cov-eq-zero">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.jointGaussian_indepFun_iff_cov_eq_zero</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>For scalar jointly Gaussian variables, independence is equivalent to zero covariance.  This is
the scalar Hansen-facing form of the uncorrelated-subvector property in Theorem 5.3. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X Y : Ω → Real},
  ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw (fun ω =&gt; { fst := X ω, snd := Y ω }) P →
    Iff (ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y P) (Eq (ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y P) 0)</code></pre>
</details>

<p class="declaration-meta"><a href="https://github.com/apoorvalal/lean-hansen-econometrics/blob/main/HansenEconometrics/MultivariateNormal.lean#L204">HansenEconometrics/MultivariateNormal.lean:204</a></p>

<details class="result-group" id="theorem-5-13-likelihood-ratio-f-test-layer">
<summary><span>Theorem 5.13 likelihood-ratio / $F$-test layer</span><span class="result-count">2 endpoints</span></summary>
<div class="result-body">
<div class="textbook-statement"><p>Under $H_0 : \beta_2 = 0$, if $F = \dfrac{(\tilde{\sigma}^2 - \hat{\sigma}^2)/q}{\hat{\sigma}^2/(n-k)}$, then $F \sim F_{q,n-k}$ and the test "reject $H_0$ if $F &gt; c$" has significance level $\alpha$ when $\mathbb{P}(F_{q,n-k} \ge c) = \alpha$</p></div>

<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 5.13 in classical form: the block F statistic has the classical
Fisher-Snedecor distribution under the null. This is a thin wrapper over the ratio-law result
using the standalone <code>fDist = classicalFDist</code> bridge in <code>FDist.lean</code>. </p></div>

  Real.instLT.lt 0 σ2 →

          ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw ε (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (instHSMul.hSMul σ2 1)) μ →
            ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw
